_comment: Machine-readable dependency-license policy. Documentation: dev-docs/info/DEPENDENCY_LICENSE_POLICY.md. Enforced by scripts/check_dependency_licenses.py. Edit accepted_exceptions/overrides here; keep the .md in sync.

pyinstaller.reason: Build-only freezer in requirements-build.txt (not requirements.txt) with security floor pyinstaller>=6.22.1 (GHSA-9fxf-4qw3-ghmr / onefile env spoofing). Upstream SPDX is GPL-2.0-or-later WITH Bootloader-exception: the exception covers linking/embedding the compiled bootloader and related loader files into the frozen executable so that copyleft does not extend to the distributed application; the PyInstaller toolchain itself is not imported as a runtime library.

pyinstaller-hooks-contrib.reason: Hard transitive of pyinstaller (Requires: pyinstaller-hooks-contrib>=2026.6; that floor is a constraint, not an exact pin). Dual-licensed by component: standard hooks/files are GPL-2.0-or-later (build-time analysis only); runtime hooks under _pyinstaller_hooks_contrib/rthooks are Apache-2.0 and may be embedded in frozen executables. Do not claim the package is never bundled — re-check which hooks the freeze selects. For this app's graph (pydicom, imageio, imageio_ffmpeg, cryptography, PySide6/matplotlib via PyInstaller's own hooks), contrib stdhooks such as hook-pydicom / hook-imageio* / hook-cryptography can apply at analysis time; the contrib Apache-2.0 rthook most likely to embed is pyi_rth_cryptography_openssl when cryptography is collected.
